notes.content:

More updates are planned for the near feature. [/p]

notes.title: Version 1.4 Update: Support for Linux and Steamdeck
notes.content:
The latest update to version 1.4 includes the following changes:

- Linux Support
- Steamdeck Keyboard and Controller support
- Minor fixes 

The game has been tested on Steam Deck and should now fully support Steam Input and the custom template.

notes.title: Announcement of Sibling Souls: Standalone sequel to Snowfall Symphony
notes.content:
Lola Piaoliang is excited to announce [i]Sibling Souls[/i], the next chapter in the Crustallus vampire universe! This time, we’re heading far into the future, where Crustallus vampire Lina is searching for her missing brother—only to find herself caught in the middle of a war between vampires and androids.

Like the first game, Sibling Souls is a standalone story, so you don’t need to play Snowfall Symphony to enjoy it. But if you have, you might spot a few familiar references along the way.

Based on feedback from Snowfall Symphony, Sibling Souls will feature:
[list]
[*] A longer, more immersive story
[*] More consistent character designs
[*] A stronger focus on romance
[*] And more enhancements
[/list]

The game is currently planned for release in late 2025.

Wishlist now:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383360/Sibling_Souls/
